desc: Kimber's 1911 Custom LW delivers the quality you have come to expect from a Kimber handgun. The 1911 Custom LW comes equipped with a match grade barrel and match grade trigger, giving the handgun exceptional accuracy. The barrel is topped with threading to accommodate the use of a suppressor, and suppressor-height sights come standard. Large serrations on the front and rear of the slide makes clearing the weapon, chambering a round, and performing press checks effortless. A set of ergonomic textured rubber grips and back strap texturing ensures optimal grip on the weapon
